notes.title: New Update Out Now
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

A new update to Task Force 1942 is available now. It includes the following:

[list]
[*]Manual has now been added to the game files.
[*]The 1.2 patch has now been applied to the game.
[*]Unnecessary files have been cleaned up.
[*]Dosbox speed increased for smoother playback.
[/list]

Enjoy the game.
